gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-84.639472 33.800157)',4326)::geography, 1900)
  AND p.leisure = 'park'
  AND elev.z >= 100;

```sql
WITH frog_rock AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Buffer(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-84.639472, 33.800157), 4326)::geography, 1900)::geometry AS search_area
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Union(rast) AS clipped_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT search_area FROM frog_rock))
),
parks_in_range AS (
  SELECT 
    p.park_name,
    p.geometry
  FROM 
    parks p
  WHERE 
    p.addr_city = 'Austell' AND 
    p.addr_state = 'GA' AND 
    ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geometry, (SELECT search_area FROM frog_rock), 0)
),
final_result AS (
  SELECT 
    pr.park_name,
    ST_Value(dc.clipped_rast, pr.geometry::geometry) AS elevation
  FROM 
    parks_in_range pr
  CROSS JOIN 
    dem_clip dc
  WHERE 
    ST_Contains(dc.clipped_rast, pr.geometry::geometry)
)
SELECT 
  park_name
FROM 
  final_result
WHERE 
  elevation >= 100;
```
